chart.title: Average lifetime sales per loyalty member by country

interpretation: **Broadly yes**: in every country, members generate substantial lifetime sales (**$2,094 to $3,070 each**) and visit about 49 to 69 locations. **Germany** leads with **$3,070.18** and 65.87 locations per member, while the **United States** is lowest at **$2,093.80** and 50.89 locations, despite having the largest base of 46,300 members. Sales and locations visited tend to rise together: Spain and South Africa have the most varied visits (around 69) and rank high on sales. *There is no non-member baseline in the data*, so this shows engagement, not that the program causes higher spending. Countries refer to member residence, not where purchases happened.
